slides.title: What each level holds.
slides.headline: What each level holds.

artwork.alt: BHAG, 10 to 30 years: the long-term ambition, no numbers. 3HAG, 3 years: year-3 revenue, cash and widgets; what you will be; 3 to 5 key capabilities; what you are known for. 1HAG, this year: revenue, cash, widgets and head count; ideally 3, up to 5 ranked priorities. QHAG, this quarter: the same numbers month by month; ideally 3, up to 5 ranked priorities. Individual priorities, this quarter: up to 5 work priorities including company priorities you own, and your critical number. One owner for every number and every priority.

notes: Keep this up as the reference for today. We fill in the 1HAG, QHAG and individual priorities on the board in that order.
Each 1HAG priority builds a 3HAG capability. Each QHAG priority advances a 1HAG priority. Each person’s priorities deliver the QHAG.
